responsibility: Implements the storage and lookup operations of the Rust typechecker’s global context. The file manages builtin and resolved type tables, node-to-HIR mappings, return and loop stacks, cached trait references, receiver and associated-impl metadata, associated-type mappings, autoderef/cast adjustment lists, operator-overload and enum-variant mappings, resolved predicates, and in-progress query markers, along with the context-item wrappers used to describe the currently checked function-like item.
